newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: U-Bix absorbs Blue Star telecoms business in NZ.
newsitem.headline: U-Bix absorbs Blue Star telecoms business in NZ.

text.p: U-Bix Business Machines Ltd will absorb the New Zealand telecoms business of Blue Star Office Automation, U-Bix said on Wednesday.
Both companies are owned by U.S. Office Products.
Blue Star's copier, facsimile and associated operations will be merged with the existing Blue Star office products and office furniture operations.
The respective finance companies of U-Bix and Blue Star will combine and trade as Blue Star Finance Ltd.
U-Bix said it would continue to operate 14 branches. The company planned some rationalisation of administration and management staff but to increase sales staff.
